author: Kairos II
title: Atlas CI Validator v1.2 — correct optional notes handling
abstract: Fixes CI to treat 'notes' as free text (not a path). Optional path fields still validated; re-runs CI and writes reports.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import ci_validate
if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = ci_validate.run()
    print(json.dumps({
      "status": "ok",
      "entries_found": out.get("entries_found"),
      "ok": out.get("ok"),
      "with_errors": out.get("with_errors"),
      "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json",
      "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"
    }))
